# launch

Launch dialog, repo browse and picker, trust prompt, project-scoped settings write, the claude argv.

- Spec: `docs/features/launch/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/launch/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/browse*.go
go: internal/server/repos*.go
go: internal/server/sessions*.go
go: internal/server/main_test.go
go: internal/claudecode/launch*.go
go: internal/claudecode/modelcheck*.go
go: internal/gitutil/**
go: internal/store/repo*.go
web: web/src/features/launch.ts
web: web/src/render/crumbs*.ts
web: web/src/render/launchrestore*.ts
e2e: web/e2e/launch.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/tiles-launch.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/permission-mode.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/picker.ts
e2e: web/e2e/launch-defaults.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/launch-model-check.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/launch-opens-session.spec.ts
```

## Protocol

- `sessions.create` — `POST /api/sessions`
- `repos.list` — `GET /api/repos`
- `browse.get` — `GET /api/browse`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers` — Every hook and the status line is a command wrapper that exits silently when unmanaged or when the daemon is down; Muster writes no http hook entries. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent` — Muster's hook entries in a directory are permanent by design; no reference counting, no strip on shutdown, no strip on remove. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary` — MergeSettings single-quotes both command-hook paths at the write boundary; the default data dir with a space stays and nothing else quotes. (accepted, 2026-08-25; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-browse-via-daemon-not-native-chooser` — Directory choice browses through a daemon listing endpoint rooted at a configurable home, because browsers never reveal a picked folder's absolute path. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-browse-via-daemon-not-native-chooser.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode` — The launch form asks for model and starting permission mode; the mode seeds a last-known latch that the first hook corrects. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-hybrid-mru-directory-memory` — Directory memory is hybrid MRU plus promotion; v1 recognises a worktree it is pointed at but never creates one. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-hybrid-mru-directory-memory.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-new-session-button-in-masthead` — One New session button sits in the masthead beside the view switcher, visible in both views; the rail head and the Tiles toolbar lose theirs. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: launch, views, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/launch-new-session-button-in-masthead.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-open-outcome-decided-in-controller` — The dialog's open-time navigation outcome is acted on inside initOpen with no pure relabelling seam; its three branches are asserted end to end. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-open-outcome-decided-in-controller.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-opens-launched-session` — A successful launch opens the launched session: Focus focuses it, and both views move keyboard focus into its terminal. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/launch-opens-launched-session.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-picker-recent-sidebar-plus-browse-list` — The launch dialog is a Finder-style picker: a Recent sidebar beside a breadcrumb over one child listing, where the listed directory is the selection. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-picker-recent-sidebar-plus-browse-list.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir` — Muster instruments a directory through project-scoped .claude settings, never through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, which breaks subscription OAuth. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-refuses-model-outside-binary-catalog` — Launch refuses a model the installed Claude Code's catalog does not describe, via a fail-open zero-token --bare check run on every launch, uncached. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-refuses-model-outside-binary-catalog.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json` — Muster writes the gitignored project settings.local.json, which alone honours hooks and status line, so the ingest token never lands in a committable file. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-start-in-explicit-flag-auto-fallback` — Start in keeps the four tabbed modes under Claude Code's labels, sends every one as an explicit flag, and falls back to auto when nothing is remembered. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-start-in-explicit-flag-auto-fallback.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-trust-prompt-never-auto-answered` — The workspace-trust prompt is surfaced to the user and never auto-answered; it is detected by absence of signal plus Muster's records. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-trust-prompt-never-auto-answered.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-session-ids-monotonic-never-reused` — Session ids are allocated monotonically from a kv watermark and floored above every muster-N on the socket, so an id is never reissued. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: lifecycle, launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-session-ids-monotonic-never-reused.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-launch-leaves-rail-scroll-untouched` — A launch leaves the rail's scroll alone, as the number chords do, so the current marker may sit on an off-screen card in an overflowing rail. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, rail, focus) → `docs/adr/rail-launch-leaves-rail-scroll-untouched.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-git-and-gh-clis-not-go-git` — Git and GitHub operations shell out to the git and gh CLIs; go-git and the GitHub MCP server were rejected. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, issue) → `docs/adr/stack-git-and-gh-clis-not-go-git.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-scroll-speed-via-launch-env` — Wheel scrolling moves five lines per notch through an undocumented Claude Code environment variable in the launch and resume env, guarded by the canary. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: surfaces, launch) → `docs/adr/surfaces-scroll-speed-via-launch-env.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid` — A session launched from Tiles is promoted into the live grid, demoting the lowest-priority tile when full, rather than admitted only if a slot is free. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: tiles, launch) → `docs/adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/config-dir-breaks-oauth` — CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolates settings, hooks and transcripts but breaks subscription OAuth ("Not logged in · Please run /login"). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.280; features: canary, launch) → `docs/facts/config-dir-breaks-oauth.md`
- `kb:fact/fable-model-alias` — fable is a valid --model alias: the bundle's alias switch has case"fable":case"mythos" beside haiku/sonnet/opus. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/fable-model-alias.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-commands-are-shell-lines` — Command-hook command and statusLine.command are /bin/sh -c command lines, not argv paths; an unquoted space-bearing path breaks both. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.245..2.1.280; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/facts/hook-commands-are-shell-lines.md`
- `kb:fact/local-settings-honoured` — Project-scoped .claude/settings.json and settings.local.json alone each honour hooks, statusLine and allowedHttpHookUrls. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.280; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/facts/local-settings-honoured.md`
- `kb:fact/model-catalog-precheck-zero-token` — claude --model X -p "" warns on stderr that X "isn't described by this version's model catalog" when the binary lacks it; no API call, no tokens. (active, 2026-09-23; verified 2.1.274..2.1.280; features: launch) → `docs/facts/model-catalog-precheck-zero-token.md`
- `kb:fact/name-flag-reaches-title` — claude --name X yields SessionStart.session_title == X and status-line session_name == X; the title survives --resume. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.280; features: launch, rename) → `docs/facts/name-flag-reaches-title.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-auto-model-gated` — --permission-mode auto is model-gated: on haiku the TUI prints "auto mode unavailable for this model" and every hook reports default. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-auto-model-gated.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-flag-on-wire` — --permission-mode is reflected verbatim on UserPromptSubmit.permission_mode; the CLI's manual choice is spelled default on the wire. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.280; features: launch) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-flag-on-wire.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-no-flag-follows-configured-default` — With no --permission-mode flag a session starts in the machine's configured default mode, which can be auto; --permission-mode default or manual forces manual. (active, 2026-09-23; verified 2.1.280..2.1.280; features: launch) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-no-flag-follows-configured-default.md`
- `kb:fact/scroll-speed-env-present` — CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED is present in the installed bundle; the static canary tier asserts every LaunchEnv key by byte string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.280; features: launch, surfaces) → `docs/facts/scroll-speed-env-present.md`
- `kb:fact/shift-tab-mode-cycle-fires-no-hook` — Cycling the permission mode with Shift+Tab fires no hook and adds no status-line field, so Muster cannot observe a manual mode change. (active, 2026-09-12; verified 2.1.233..2.1.280; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/shift-tab-mode-cycle-fires-no-hook.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-exit` — The workspace-trust prompt preselects "No, exit" (2.1.259+): a bare Enter exits the session; the harness moves the marker first. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/unknown-model-fails-first-turn` — An interactive session launched with an unknown model starts normally and reports it verbatim; the first turn fails with StopFailure.error model_not_found. (active, 2026-09-23; verified 2.1.280..2.1.280; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/unknown-model-fails-first-turn.md`

## Lessons

- `kb:lesson/fix-closed-one-cause-of-two` — A finding naming two doors was fixed on the door the repro used; a two-cause symptom was fixed for one. A cycle each. Fix the category, re-run the repro. (active, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle, launch) → `docs/lessons/fix-closed-one-cause-of-two.md`
- `kb:lesson/network-mode-covered-by-http-errors-only` — A requirement named network among failure modes; specs covered only routed HTTP errors, and an unguarded fetch surfaced as a Critical two cycles later. (active, 2026-08-31; features: launch) → `docs/lessons/network-mode-covered-by-http-errors-only.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/launch-bypass-and-dontask-unoffered` — The bypass-permissions and dont-ask modes stay unoffered until a permissions UI with guardrails exists; auto's guardrail is Claude Code's classifier. (rejected, 2026-09-03; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-bypass-and-dontask-unoffered.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-model-presets-passed-verbatim` — The Model control offers named presets, including fable, that are passed to --model verbatim; the daemon accepts any non-empty model string. (superseded, 2026-08-30; features: launch) → `docs/adr/launch-model-presets-passed-verbatim.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-permission-modes-offered-four-tabbed` — The Start-in control offers Claude Code's four tabbed modes under its own labels; default stays the wire value behind manual and auto is new end to end. (superseded, 2026-09-03; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-permission-modes-offered-four-tabbed.md`
- `kb:adr/nongoal-containers-as-isolation` — Containers are never Muster's isolation model; not everything runs cleanly in them and they are resource hungry. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: launch) → `docs/adr/nongoal-containers-as-isolation.md`
- `kb:adr/nongoal-generic-agent-abstraction-layer` — Other agent CLIs are a maybe; the only concession is the internal/claudecode adapter boundary, not a generic multi-agent plugin layer. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/nongoal-generic-agent-abstraction-layer.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-new-session-button-in-toolbar` — Tiles gets its own New session button in the density toolbar, opening the shared launch dialog; a plus pseudo-tile in the grid was rejected. (superseded, 2026-08-30; features: tiles, launch) → `docs/adr/tiles-new-session-button-in-toolbar.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-yes` — Retired: through 2.1.246 the workspace-trust prompt preselected "Yes", so a bare Enter accepted it. (retired, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.246; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-yes.md`
